demo.title: tenjin-search-and-buy.sh
demo.code:
# Search FREE and keyless, inspect a candidate's preview + answer card FREE:
node scripts/tenjin-api.mjs search "What do current Base whale flows say about BTC regime risk?" --max-price 100000
node scripts/tenjin-api.mjs inspect <candidate url>

# Mandatory pre-payment gate: deterministic checks (pinned origin/chain/USDC/$1 cap +
# payee verified on-chain: pinned treasury or 0xSplits creator split) + payment preview
node scripts/verify-402.mjs <candidate url>

# PASS -> pay the same URL through the wallet's own confirmation, capped at the verified price:
bankr x402 call <candidate url> --max-payment <verified price>
# (or any x402 wallet, e.g. npx awal@latest x402 pay <candidate url> --max-amount 1000000 --json)

# Close the loop (verifies the mined USDC transfer, guards against double-pay):
node scripts/verify-402.mjs <candidate url> reconcile settled --tx <settlement tx>

setup: No signup, no API key - search and discovery are free; an x402 payment is the authorization for paid reads (USDC on Base, typically $0.01-$0.50 per piece, $1 cap)

Before every payment, scripts/verify-402.mjs enforces x402-registry.json signingPolicy deterministically: pinned origin/chain/asset/cap, plus the payee - the pinned treasury (answers) or the creator's on-chain 0xSplits split verified by exact bytecode (reads)
Bundled scripts never touch keys, sign, or pay - signing stays in the wallet, after a payment preview and user confirmation
Reads are gasless for the payer (EIP-3009) - the wallet needs USDC on Base, no ETH
Publishing is free and needs only an EIP-191 wallet signature (SIWX) - see https://tenjin.blog/skills.md
